title: 3.0 - errors baking models

milestone.description:
New major release that breaks compatibility with 2.x

- PHP5.4.19+
- New ORM & behaviors.
- Improved Routing
- PSR-0 and composer support.
- Simpler configuration and bootstrapping.
- Improved configuration handling.
- Improved bake.

See [the roadmap](http://github.com/cakephp/cakephp/wiki/3.0-roadmap) for more details.

body:
In random baking test for 3.0 i found this, running:

``` Shell
cake bake model Teams
```

Some errors (notice) and exceptions pop up for test generation, other tasks are ok:

``` Shell
Notice Error: Undefined index: model in [/app/vendor/cakephp/cakephp/src/Console/Command/Task/TestTask.php, line 267]
[...]
Exception: Invalid object type. in [/app/vendor/cakephp/cakephp/src/Console/Command/Task/TestTask.php, line 285]
```
